'''Violet-rated constable''' was, along with [[ultraviolet-rated constable]], one of the two ranks of [[Officer/Legends|officers]] that composed the upper leadership of the [[Sullustan Constable Brigade]], the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] arm of the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]], which ruled the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. Like the other brigade ranks, the rank of violet-ranked constable was named for a [[Color/Legends|color]] of light.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
The rank of violet-rated constable was mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
